title: Blender Cover Remix
author: bandinopla
description:
Entry for the [Make a Splash in Amsterdam](https://blenderartists.org/t/wip-log-junk-shop-renderman/1400567) contest!
Combined 2 Blender covers into one scene. I also did a complete retopology of the models to reduce poly-count. Some other modifications on the characters too.
changes: Repacked as a single GLB; textures limited to 1024px; geometry compressed/quantized with gltf-transform Meshopt without simplification; PNG textures compressed with lossless WebP; default camera embedded; preview rendered with MuTracer and denoised with OIDN standard.
